subject: English
passage: Before the 1990s implementation of online course registration systems, students typically had to register for classes in person by waiting in long lines at various departmental offices, and these offices often had limited hours and staff. ______ completing course registration could take entire days, and students frequently found themselves shut out of popular classes that filled up quickly.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. "Consequently" logically signals that the registration problems described in this sentence (time-consuming process, students shut out of classes) were a consequence of the in-person registration system described in the previous sentence.
